layouts.name: Gateway Motorsports Park
layouts.description: The supplied general configuration displays the oval together with the original infield course. The operator distinguishes both physical circuits. This independently georeferenced historical configuration set excludes the later road extension, karting, dragway and pit access. Its unique-edge distance is not a timed lap. Source direction and fine centerline alignment remain draft. Independently digitized aerial branch network: 3447.5 m. Shared edges count once; this configuration set is not a single lap, and no line joins separate paths. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

layouts.name: Gateway Motorsports Porsche 2mile
layouts.description: The longer supplied configuration retains the original northern infield course, middle eastward connector, outer southern oval arc, inner southern extension and original infield southern return. These physical branches are independently visible in pinned public-domain 2019 NAIP imagery. The operator identifies the enlarged road-course facility; the temporary paddock rectangle in the general operator plan is excluded because it is absent from this supplied configuration. Historical branch choice, direction and fine centerline alignment remain draft. Coordinates are not fitted to a private diagram or scalar distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3117.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
